heading: Sunday
text: Mostly cloudy. Scattered rain showers spreading north, with a chance of afternoon thunderstorms. Highs from the mid 70s to near 80. South wind near 10 mph.

heading: Sunday Night
text: Mostly cloudy, with showers in the evening, becoming spotty overnight. Partial clearing late. Lows in the 50s to near 60. Southwest wind near 10 mph.

heading: Monday
text: Partly cloudy south of Rt. 4, increasing clouds north with rain showers. Showers spreading in the afternoon with a chance of thunderstorms. Cooler. Highs from the mid to upper 70s. Southwest wind near 10 mph.
